spans.s:
उद्वत् a.
1 Excellent.
--2 Raised,
elevated. --f. An elevation, hill
(Ved.).

To pour out, send
forth.
--2 To raise, elevate.

1 A gift, donation.
--2
Pouring or shaking out.

1 Ejection, throwing out.
--2 Shaving.
--3 (In logic)
Nonexistence of a subsequent
consequent on the absence of an
antecedent (Wilson).
--4 Rooting up.
--5 Raising, elevating.

उद्वम् {c1c} P. To throw up, eject,
vomit (fig. also); उद्ववाम वरौ

उद्वांत^1 p. p.
1 Vomited.
--2 Out of
rut (as an elephant).
--3 Dropped
down; Ś. 6.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170209. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/336. note: seems to be misspelled when copied from MW72.

उद्वयस् a. Throwing down food
(as wind) (अन्नापातक).

उद्वस् Caus. To banish, expel,
drive away.

1 Expelling, banishing.
--2 Abandoning.
--3 Taking out of
or away (from the fire).
--4
Killing, slaughter.

उद्वास्य a.
1 Relating to the
killing of a sacrificial animal.
--2 To
be raised or lifted up.
--3 To be
taken out or extracted.

उद्वस a From which honey has
been extracted (as a bee-hive);

उद्वास, --सस् a. One who has put
off one's clothes.

To marry, lead
home (as a bride); पार्थिवीमुदवहद्रघूद्वहः

.
--2 To bear up, raise up, elevate.
--3
To hold up, sustain, support;
पदमुद्वहंती

adhering to his
master's cause.
--5 To possess, have,
assume, be endowed with;
पुरुषाभिमानमुद्वहद्भिः

;
so शब्दं, अंगुलिं, पाणिं, ज्ञानं, गर्वं,
प्रमोदं &c.
--6 To carry off or
away, take or lead away; तमुद्वहंतं
पथि भोजकन्यां

.
--7 To
lead to termination, finish;
प्रारब्धमुत्तमजनास्त्वमिवोद्वहंति

To cause to marry.
--2 To spread above; Śi. 12. 73.

उद्वह a.
1 Carrying, leading up,
taking up or away.
--2 Continuing,
perpetuating (as a family); कुल˚

; 11. 54.
--3 Eminent, head, principal, best,
foremost.
--हः
1 A son.
--2 One
(i. e. the 4th) of the seven courses
of air.
--3 The vital air which
conveys nourishment upwards.
--4
One of the seven tongues of fire.
--5 Marriage.
--हा A daughter.

1 Marrying.
--2
Supporting, holding or lifting up, bearing,
carrying; भुवः प्रयुक्तोद्वहनक्रियायाः

.
--3
Being carried on, riding;
खरेणोद्वहनं तथा

1 Bearing up, supporting.
--2 Marriage, wedding; असवर्णास्वयं
ज्ञेयो विधिरुद्वाहकर्मणि

. (The
Smṛtis mention {8} forms of
marriage:
--ब्राह्मो दैवस्तथा चार्षः
प्राजापत्यस्तथासुरः । गांधर्वो राक्षसश्चैव पैशाचश्चाष्टमः स्मृतः ॥).

उद्वाहन a. That which raises or
draws up (in comp.); घटीयंत्रं
सलिलोद्वाहनं प्रहेः Ak.
--नं
1 Lifting up.
--2
Ploughing a field twice.
--3 Marriage.
--4 Anxiety, anxious regret.
--नी
1
A cord, rope.
--2 A small shell,
cowarie (वराटिका).

उद्वाहित p. p.
1 Raised, lifted
up.
--2 Married.
--3 Eradicated,
pulled up.

उद्वाहिन् a.
1 Raising, drawing up.
--2 Marrying.
--नी A rope, cord.

उद्वान a. Vomited, ejected.
--नं
1 Ejecting, vomiting.
--2 A stove.

उद्वास, --सस् a. One who has put
off one's clothes.

उद्विज् {c6c} A. (P. epic.)
1 To be
grieved or afflicted, be agitated;
नोद्विजेत्प्राप्यं चाप्रियं

; tremble,
shake (lit. and fig.).
--2 To
fear, be afraid of, shrink from,
abhor (with abl.); तीक्ष्णादुद्विजते

.
--3 To be tired or sick of,
be disgusted with; जीवितादुद्विजमानेन

; sometimes with gen.; या
ममोद्विजते नित्यं साद्य मामवगूहते

To trouble, harass, afflict,
oppress; उद्वेजयत्यंगुलिपार्ष्णिभागान्

.
--3
To produce disgust or abhorrence;
रमणीयाप्युद्वेजयति

To fan.
--2 To blow
upon or towards.

उद्विग्न p. p.
1 Grieved, afflicted,
sorrowful, anxious (as for any
absent lover); ˚चित्त, --मनस् depressed
in mind, sorry, anxious.
--2
Alarmed, frightened;

उद्वेग a. [उद्गतो वेगोऽस्मात्]
1 Going
swiftly (as an express messenger),
[]
courier.
--2 Steady, calm, tranquil.
--3 Ascending, mounting.
--4 One
whose arms by long practice
continue always raised above the head
(as an ascetic).
--गः
1 Trembling,
shaking, waving.
--2 Agitation,
excitement;

.
--4 Anxiety, regret, sorrow,
distress (caused by separation from
one's favourite object.).
--5
Admiration, astonishment.
--गं A
betelnut (fruit.).

उद्वेजि(गि)न्, --जक a.
1 Agitating,
distressing, causing pain or distress.
--2 Suffering distress, anxious,
unhappy.

उद्वेजि(गि)न्, --जक a.
1 Agitating,
distressing, causing pain or distress.
--2 Suffering distress, anxious,
unhappy.

उद्वेजि(गि)न्, --जक a.
1 Agitating,
distressing, causing pain or distress.
--2 Suffering distress, anxious,
unhappy.

उद्वेजन a. Causing to tremble
(with fear); hurting the feelings.
--नं
1 Agitation, anxiety.
--2
Infliction of pain, torture, affliction;
उद्वेजनकरैर्दंडैश्चिह्नयित्वा प्रवासयेत्

painful.
--3 Regret, sorrow
for one's absence.

To look up, view,
see, perceive; दृष्टिरधिकं
सोत्कंठमुद्वीक्षते

1 Looking up or upwards.
--2 Sight, an eye; seeing, looking
at; सखीजनोद्वीक्षणकौमुदीमुखं

To go upwards,
ascend.
--2 To fly asunder, burst out;
उद्वर्तमानमूलबंधनं

the strings
of which are giving way or being
snapped.
--3 To tumble over, fall
down.
--4 To go out, depart.
--5
To rise, swell, increase.
--6 To be
puffed up with pride, be haughty.
--

To extirpate, eradicate,
destroy; उद्वर्तितं रसांतरेण लज्जालुत्वं

.
--2 To throw up, elevate.
--3 To turn round, roll (as eyes).
--4 To anoint, smear.

उद्वर्त a.
1 Superfluous,
redundant, plentiful.
--2 Left over as a
remainder, surplus.
--र्तः
1 A
remainder, surplus.
--2 Excess,
[]
preponderance.
--3 Rubbing or
smearing the body with perfumes.

उद्वर्तक a.
1 Causing to rise.
--2
Rubbing and cleaning the body.
--कः (In Math.) The quantity
assumed for the purpose of the
operation (Colebrooke).

1 Going up, rising.
--2
Springing up, growth (of plants,
grain &c.).
--3 Prosperity,
elevation.
--4 Turning from side to side;
springing up, popping the head;
चटुलशफरोद्वर्तनप्रेक्षितानि^1

.
--5
Griding, pounding.
--6 Drawing
out metal, wire-drawing.
--7
Anointing, smearing; करोद्वर्तनार्थे
चंदनं समर्पयामि.
--8 Particularly,
rubbing and cleaning the body with
perfumes or fragrant unguents, or
the unguents used for this
purpose or to relieve pain;

(
अभ्यंगमलापकर्षणपिष्टकादि Kull.).
--9 Bad behaviour or
conduct, rudeness.
[1] Correction submitted by User geymonat on 20211001. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/659.

उद्वर्तित a.
1 Risen, elevated.
--2
Sprung up, drawn out.
--3
Perfumed, scented, rubbed, kneaded.

उद्वृत्त p. p.
1 Raised, elevated
(स्तन, दंत, मेघ &c.).
--2 Flowing out,
not contained in, swollen,
overflowing; हृदयभरितोद्वृत्तविस्मय

overflowing;
उद्वृतः क इव सुखावहः परेषां Śi. 8. 18.
(where उ˚ means also ‘gone astray,
ill-behaved’).
--3 Grown, increased.
--4 Exalted, prosperous.
--5 Proud,
furious, haughty; ˚मृगपति

.
--6 Vomited up.
--7 Left as a
remainder.
--8 Ill-conducted,
ill-mannered, rude.
--9 Agitated;
उद्वृत्तनक्रात् सहसोन्ममज्ज

raise up, elevate.
--2
To draw up, eradicate, uproot.

उद्वेदि a. [उन्नता वेदिर्यत्र] Having a
raised seat or throne in it; विमानं
नवमुद्वेदि

उद्वेल a. [उत्क्रांतो वेलां]
1
Overflowing its banks (as a river);
भयमप्रलयोद्वेलादाचख्युर्नैरृतोदधेः

.
--2
To roll or move about, turn round;
उद्वेल्लंति पुराणचंदनतरुस्कंधेषु कुंभीनसाः

उद्वेल्लित p. p. Shaken, tossed up.
--तं Shaking.

उद्वेष्ट a. Investing,
surrounding, covering on all sides.
--ष्टः
1
Surrounding.
--2 Investing or
besieging (as a town &c.).
--3
Devastating.
--4 Overcoming in battle.

.
--2
Freed from bonds, unfettered,
unbound.
--नं
1 The act of
surrounding or enclosing.
--2 An enclosure,
fence.
--3 A pain in the buttocks
or back of the body; हृदय˚
convulsive pain in the heart.

उद्वेष्टयति Den. P. To open,
unfasten, untie.
